current.name: Style Showcase
current.notes:
🌅 *PATCH 1.0.2 — STYLE SHOWCASE*

🥋 *Fighting style art is HERE.* Every style now has a unique icon. See yours with *.style <name>*.

📊 *Web dashboard* — view Mora, items, styles, events, and trade values at your Railway URL.

🎯 *Map rework* — *.map* now shows terrain selection first, then difficulty buttons with level locks.

💊 *Consumables fixed* — healing capsules, energy capsules, and all consumable items now work properly.

👤 *Admin names on moderation* — bans, warns, kicks now show who did it.

🔗 *Faction group links updated* — new working invite links for all 3 factions.

💬 *Star personality* — battle commentary, idle messages, and tips from your guide.

📈 *Progression engine* — scalable XP curves, honor/bounty/resonance system, anti-farming.

🎫 *.styles--wind-step* — Star's guide to the first fighting style. Type it to see!
